Times and relationships come from the local session log. Bars share one time scale; overlapping bars represent overlapping work. Unknown or missing endings are marked explicitly. Full payloads may contain private conversation data. Existing sessions show only events that were recorded.
The start is outside this window or was not recorded. Load earlier events for more context.
Make instructions, scripts, references and assets available as complete versioned packages. Only enabled skills are exposed to the assistant.
Copy or verify a package when the assistant calls use_skill. When off, the assistant can request termux_skill_sync explicitly.
Absolute path inside Termux home. An app-specific subdirectory is added. Changing this path keeps old copies in their previous directory.

Requires Python in Termux (pkg install python). Sync copies files only; scripts and dependency installation remain explicit agent actions. Copies are separate from the originals in The Trickster\'s Pocket.
This removes all managed skill revisions in the selected directory. Stop jobs that use them first. Original skills in The Trickster\'s Pocket are kept and can be synced again.
TPS uses only measured streaming content time; waiting and tool execution are excluded. Missing measurements are shown as —. Totals cover the loaded, selected runs and provider-reported usage.
